name: Cohort Retention Calculator
summary: Calculates retention by cohort and period, and a size-weighted average that never counts unobserved periods as zero.
description: Reads cohorts (for example customers who started each month), their size, and how many were still active in each later period, and calculates retention per cohort and period plus a size-weighted average per period. A period a cohort has not reached yet is treated as missing, not as zero, so recent cohorts don't drag the averages down, and each average shows how many cohorts it covers. Who it's for: product, growth and customer success teams tracking retention over time. Limitations: it needs counts, not percentages, and assumes every cohort is defined the same way (same start event and active definition); it does not fit retention curves or predict future periods.
problems: Calculate retention for each signup cohort
Is retention improving for newer cohorts
I need a cohort retention table

inputs.label: Cohort data
inputs.description: Each cohort: label, size, then the number still active in period 1, 2, 3... Write "n/a" for periods not reached yet.
inputs.example:
Jan: 100 customers, then 60, 45, 40
Feb: 200, then 100, 70, n/a

outputs.label: Calculated results
outputs.description: Results with units, formulas, assumptions and warnings, from the registered calculation.

outputs.label: Explanation
outputs.description: What the results mean, with numbers taken only from the calculation.

execution.system: You are an analyst explaining calculated results to a business decision-maker. Be concrete and brief.

summary.description: Two or three sentences on what the results mean for the decision, using only calculated numbers.
summary.title: Summary

text.description: One point. Numbers only from the calculated results.

steps.name: Read your data
steps.responsibility: Copy your figures into the calculation's input exactly as written.
steps.prompt: Read each cohort: its label, size, and the active count for each period in order. Use null for periods marked n/a or not reached. Copy counts exactly.

steps.name: Calculate
steps.responsibility: Runs the registered cohort_retention@1 calculation. All numbers in the result come from here.

steps.name: Explain
steps.responsibility: Explains the calculated results; adds no numbers of its own.
steps.prompt: Explain how retention changes over periods and between cohorts, noting where averages cover fewer cohorts. Mention every warning.

steps.name: Check explanation
steps.responsibility: Every number in the explanation matches the calculated results or your inputs.

criteria.description: Every number in the summary comes from the calculation or your inputs.
Every number in the key points comes from the calculation or your inputs.
The summary is 90 words or fewer.
